notes: Pins down the classic off-by-one: a naive `candidate.hasPrefix(root)` string check would wrongly treat /srv/server1x as inside root /srv/server1, since the literal characters match as a prefix. resolvedServerFileURL's actual guard checks `candidatePath.hasPrefix(rootPath + "/")` (line 53) specifically to avoid that — this fixture proves the port keeps the '+ separator' guard and correctly rejects the sibling as an escape rather than reintroducing the bug.
